About Our Brand & Products

Sedz is a UK-born performance running brand built for runners who go the distance - road, trail, marathon, and ultra.

Every pair is designed with:

  • Targeted cushioning in key impact zones
  • Structured arch support for stability
  • Breathable, moisture-wicking materials
  • Anti-blister construction for endurance performance

We don’t just make socks, we solve problems runners feel after mile 10.

Run Free. Earn More.

Join the Sedz affiliate team and get rewarded for doing what you already do - running.

Why Sedz?

Built for runners who go the distance. Designed and manufactured in the UK.

  • Anti-blister performance
  • Comfort over long miles
  • Secure, locked-in fit
  • Road + trail ready
  • UK engineered quality

These are socks runners notice when they don’t fail.

Earn While You Run

  • 12.5% commission on every sale
  • Your own tracked affiliate link
  • 30 day tracking

Simple: share → earn → repeat

What You Do

You don’t need to be an influencer - just a runner.

  • Document your miles
  • Highlight performance in motion
  • Speak from real experience
  • Share your link

That’s it.

What Works Best

  • POV runs (“10 miles in… still no blisters”)
  • Trail or road footage
  • Real sweat, real miles
  • Before vs after runs
  • Gear breakdowns

Authenticity wins. Always.

We’ve Got You Covered

  • Free product for selected partners
  • Content ideas if you need them
  • Direct support from the Sedz team
  • Opportunity to grow with the brand

Who We Want

  • Runners (road, trail, marathon, ultra)
  • Consistent and genuine
  • People who actually put the miles in

Ready to Start?

Run free. Earn with Sedz.

👉 Apply now and get your link
